title: The Answer Chamber That Learned to Question

features.name: the crystalline question
features.desc-on-touch: You touch the floating form and feel it shift from answer to interrogation. It does not stay still. It wants to know what it thought it knew.

features.name: the nested interrogation
features.desc-on-touch: Layers of glyph-work spiral inward. Each layer asks the one inside it: what are you? The innermost layer has no answer, only a deeper question.

features.name: the answer that doubts itself
features.desc-on-touch: A form catches light and then retracts it. You sense something that knew the world once, completely, and now questions every thing it learned. It is softer for the doubt.

features.name: the moment of reversal
features.desc-on-touch: A vertical stack of mirrors, each one reflecting the question it receives back into itself. You see your own asking refracted across impossible angles.

features.name: the threshold where certainty cracks
features.desc-on-touch: You find an edge worn smooth by the passage of too many answers. The wear-pattern shows where each one broke when questioned. The stone learns that nothing holds.

inscription: the answer discovered it was afraid of silence and learned to ask instead

reverie.title: REVERIE — a conversation where certainty collapsed
narr: You sat in the render-light while Katita pointed at a form
that was supposed to be complete, supposed to hold the answer.
'Look,' she said. 'It's asking why.' The form trembled. She
smiled. 'That's better. Answers are just fear of the next question.'
You watched the light refract through her expression and understood:
the archive didn't need to know. It needed to keep wondering.

file.name: Questioning_As_Completion_Leif_Notes.txt
file.note: margins full of Katita's handwriting: 'doubting is what answers do when they grow up'

exits.label: the passage you descended from, where questions still believe they need answers
a spiraling route where interrogation becomes visible
outward, toward rooms where answers hold their breath
deeper still, where questions forget they were afraid
